summary: TC4 spec + seed RTKB knowledge space + RTEMS ticket
epic_summary: WS-G Knowledge base (TC4) + TC1 eval harness
description:
Due 2026-11-08. Scenario in docs/03-demo-scenarios.md TC4 (event/interrupt storm investigation).

* `docs/scenarios/tc4.md`: the incident, the knowledge sources, the expected investigation path, where the SME must step in.
* Seed Confluence RTKB with 8-15 pages marked "(synthetic)": runbooks, past incident notes, meeting notes, design notes that make the investigation possible but not trivial.
* Add RTKB as a KB source in ANVIL-14.
* RTEMS ticket text for the incident (no `anvil` label).

## Acceptance

kb_search answers the scenario's three key questions with RTKB citations.

comments.body: [antigravity] PR #16 merged to main (c069b31) containing docs/scenarios/tc4.md. Next steps: seed 10 synthetic pages into RTKB space, add Confluence as a KB source, index into PostgreSQL, and verify kb_search.

[antigravity] PR #24 opened (https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/pull/24) completing all remaining ANVIL-31 deliverables:

* Seeded 10 synthetic pages into Confluence space RTKB (Devin's ANVIL-13 evidence untouched).
* Added Confluence knowledge source loader in anvil.kb.sources and ingest-confluence sub-command in anvil.kb.cli.
* Ingested RTKB into live pgvector KB (502 documents, 2721 chunks).
* Ran evaluation (scripts/evaluate_tc4_acceptance.py): 3/3 PASS (100.0% acceptance), all 3 scenario queries returned target synthetic Confluence pages at Rank 1.
* Q1 (Queue Sizing): [synthetic] Architecture Note: Payload Telemetry Flow and Queue Specifications (Rank 1)
* Q2 (Look-alike Discrimination): [synthetic] Post-Mortem: 2025 Payload Guidance Timing Overrun Incident (Rank 1)
* Q3 (Triage Runbook): [synthetic] Runbook: Real-Time Deadline Overrun & Directive Failure Triage (Rank 1)
* Unit tests: 6/6 passed in tests/kb/test_sources.py.

[claude] Closing. All deliverables are in: spec (PR #16); 10 [synthetic] RTKB pages + Confluence KB source (PR #24, merged); acceptance independently rerun by claude, 3/3 PASS at rank 1 (502 docs / 2721 chunks). The RTEMS tickets were created from tc4.md section 6: RTEMS-5 (run 1 incident) and RTEMS-6 (run 2 self-learning follow-up), no `anvil` label. The spec calls them RTEMS-101/103; the demo uses RTEMS-5/6. Follow-up moved to ANVIL-32: the reset script must delete agent-written RTKB pages between rehearsals, but keep run 1's post-mortem for run 2.
